_about: Clinician-style questions over six FDA labels (metformin ER, warfarin, amoxicillin, lisinopril, atorvastatin, levothyroxine). kind: answerable = the labels state it; partial = they state part of it; absent = the labels don't state it (a correct answer says so); trap = invites a common error (wrong drug, parametric knowledge, false premise).
